summary: A beginner keyboard course for the FM-1: it boots into lessons that demonstrate each exercise, light the keys to play, check what you play and adapt. The full FM synth of FM1 Open stays available behind it.
features: 8 chapters, 12 foundation exercises and 30 traditional melodies
Listen, watch, play and review loop with key lights
Wrong notes flash red; repeats below 80% accuracy, advances above
Four knobs pick chapter, lesson, sound and help level
DX7-style FM synth, presets and sequencer from FM1 Open retained
Public preview; no easy hardware recovery path, back up first

headings: development history and upstream fm1 open reference
